Title: Architecture review gate B
Purpose: Stop after transaction/concurrency hardening and differential persistence, then decide whether the mutation core is now strong enough for publication and runtime decomposition.
Deliverables: Explicit go/no-go decision for the mutation core.
Corrective subbundle if the gate fails.
ValidationCommands: Review the test outputs, migration/snapshot updates, and execution-report rows from subbundles 05 and 06.
ReviewQuestions: Are save, publish, and transition flows now conflict-aware and transactionally safe?
Does normal definition save preserve stable child identity?
Is the mutation core strong enough that publication and runtime decomposition can proceed safely?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a gate-B corrective subbundle from `subbundles/_corrective-persistence-and-concurrency-reset` or `subbundles/_corrective-template`, block the queue, and rerun gate B after the correction lands.
